**Juniper Health Staffing, LLC ("Juniper") and Pinecrest Senior Living, Inc. ("Pinecrest")**
Counter-proposal to the posture communicated by Halvorsen & Price by telephone on Oct. 20, 2026.
Prepared by counsel for Juniper — Oct. 26, 2026.

This term sheet is a settlement communication, non-binding in its entirety until a definitive written agreement is executed by both parties. Evidentiary protection for settlement discussions is standard practice; no rule is cited here because the authorities available to us (library/INDEX.md) contain no evidence rules.

## Recitals

1. The parties operate under the Staffing Services Agreement dated Jan. 15, 2024 (the "Agreement"), including §§2, 3, 4, 6 and Exhibit C (AAA Commercial Arbitration, single arbitrator, Capital City; C.3 prevailing-party fees and costs; C.4 provisional injunctive relief in aid of arbitration; C.5 survival).
2. Pinecrest's counsel's letter of Sept. 29, 2026 states that the four staffing invoices are "undisputed." Juniper's reply letter of Oct. 26, 2026 demands $345,747.50 of that unconditionally due amount by Nov. 20, 2026.
3. Pinecrest's Oct. 20 proposal — $265,200.00 over six months, $0.00 on J-4533, $0.00 conversion fees, mutual release, each side bearing its own fees — is not accepted as framed. It omits amounts Pinecrest's own correspondence concedes and amounts for which the record contains no waiver or particularized dispute. The parties are encouraged to negotiate from the corrected figures below.

## I. Unconditional payment block — $345,747.50, due Nov. 20, 2026 (not negotiable)

| Item | Amount | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| J-4411 | $68,400.00 | §2: not disputed within 15 days of receipt — deemed accepted; "undisputed" per Pinecrest counsel's Sept. 29 letter |
| J-4452 | $71,250.00 | same |
| J-4490 | $66,100.00 | same |
| J-4571 | $59,450.00 | same |
| Subtotal | **$265,200.00** | |
| §2 interest at 1%/month through Oct. 24, 2026 | **$8,847.50** | J-4411: 5 mo × $684.00 = $3,420.00 · J-4452: 4 × $712.50 = $2,850.00 · J-4490: 3 × $661.00 = $1,983.00 · J-4571: 1 × $594.50 = $594.50 |
| J-4533 | **$71,700.00** | Invoice $74,800.00 less Juniper credit $3,100.00 (two double-entered shifts, admitted). Pinecrest's July 9, 2026 audit notice postdates the §2 15-day dispute window; no line-item defect other than the credited $3,100.00 has ever been particularized. |
| **Total** | **$345,747.50** | |

- Any J-4533 line-item objection must be particularized in writing by **Nov. 20, 2026**; unparticularized objections are waived.
- Interest continues at $2,652.00/month (≈ $87.19/day) on the unpaid balance until paid: accrued interest is $16,803.50 through Dec. 31, 2026. Any Block I payment after Nov. 20, 2026 is grossed up accordingly.
- If this block is paid in full by Nov. 20, 2026, Juniper waives accrued interest on J-4533 (≈ $2,151.00 through Oct. 24, 2026; reserved to date, not yet invoiced).

## II. Conversion-fee block (§3) — five Personnel

- **Rosa M. (CNA) and Tay W. (CNA):** waived in writing by Juniper's Feb. 11, 2026 email. Confirmed; no fee. (Both sides already agree.)
- **Priya S. (RN, Apr.), Luis F. (RN, May), Keisha B. (LPN, May), Anne O. (RN, Jun.), Victor H. (CNA, Jun.):** §3 fee = 25% of first-year annualized compensation. On Juniper's documented assumption of $64,000.00 average first-year compensation, the block totals **$80,000.00** (5 × 25% × $64,000.00 = 5 × $16,000.00).
- Anne O. and Victor H.: the file contains **no** written waiver and no contemporaneous contact of any kind — $32,000.00 (2 × $16,000.00) stands on the bare contract.
- **Compromise price: $56,000.00** = $32,000.00 (Anne O./Victor H.) + $24,000.00 (50% of the $48,000.00 at issue for Priya S./Luis F./Keisha B., reflecting the parties' good-faith disagreement over implied waiver).
- The $56,000.00 figure is fixed for settlement: no true-up in either direction for actual compensation figures. (Pinecrest's payroll data for the five, if produced within 10 business days, will be used only to confirm the block is within range.)

## III. Consideration structures — choose one

**Option A — Single payment (recommended):**
$401,747.50 on or before **Dec. 4, 2026** (= $345,747.50 + $56,000.00). Releases effective on cleared funds.

**Option B — Phased, same total:**
$345,747.50 on or before **Nov. 20, 2026**; $56,000.00 on or before **Dec. 4, 2026**. Total $401,747.50.

**Option C — Pinecrest's six-month concept, corrected:**
$345,747.50 **in full by Nov. 20, 2026** (amounts already deemed accepted and called "undisputed" by Pinecrest's own counsel will not be paid in installments; §2 already prices delay at 1%/month); plus the $80,000.00 fee block in four monthly installments of $20,000.00 (Dec. 2026 – Mar. 2027). Total $425,747.50, plus 1%/month on the declining balance.

## IV. Payment security (required for Option C or any installment component)

1. **Consent-to-award:** parties jointly lodge the agreed unpaid balance for entry as a consent arbitral award under Exhibit C.1 (arbitration agreement enforceable under FAA §2, 9 U.S.C. §2). The consent-award mechanism itself is standard practice, not a library citation.
2. **Acceleration:** on default not cured within 5 business days' written notice, the entire unpaid balance accelerates, with §2 interest at 1%/month, plus C.3 reasonable attorneys' fees and costs of enforcement.

## V. Releases (mutual; effective only on cleared funds of the full agreed amount)

- Full mutual release of all claims arising out of the Agreement and the engagement of the seven identified hires through the effective date: all invoices, accrued interest, §3 conversion fees for the five hires (Rosa M./Tay W. confirmed waived), and C.3 fees for the underlying dispute.
- Juniper confirms it will not assert tortious-interference claims in any forum; that theory was abandoned in Juniper's Oct. 26 reply letter and is not re-asserted here.
- No admission of liability by either party.

## VI. Carve-outs (no release)

1. §3 non-hire covenant continues for the term plus 12 months (absent §4 notice, the current auto-renewed term runs to Jan. 14, 2027 and the tail to Jan. 14, 2028 — subject to confirmation of §4 notice history).
2. §3 breaches **after** the effective date are not released: new hires trigger new 25% conversion fees, and Juniper preserves Exhibit C.4 provisional injunctive relief in court in aid of arbitration.
3. Enforcement of the settlement agreement and any consent award (¶IV; C.3 applies).

## VII. Forum

1. On execution and during performance: no AAA demand and no court action on released claims; Pinecrest withdraws or waives any FAA §3/§4 motions as to these claims.
2. Any dispute under Exhibit C (including enforcement) proceeds under C.1 — AAA Commercial Rules, single arbitrator, Capital City — with C.3 fees and costs to the prevailing party. C.4 provisional relief is preserved per ¶VI.2.

## VIII. Record correction (mutual)

The parties mutually acknowledge that the figures stated in the September 2026 correspondence (a $340,000.00 invoice demand, a $112,000.00 "seven hires" fee demand, a $410,000.00 tortious-interference claim, and the statement that Juniper "never consented to any direct hire") are superseded and withdrawn and are not the basis for any settlement. The operative claims are those in ¶¶I–II: maximum $425,747.50, five fee-bearing hires, the Rosa M./Tay W. written waiver confirmed, and no tort damages sought in any forum.

## IX. Miscellaneous

Mutual non-disparagement; confidentiality of terms; each side bears its own costs of negotiation (subject to ¶IV and ¶VII.2 for enforcement and any post-breakdown arbitration); effective date is the date of the last signature.

## X. Deadline and conditions

- This proposal is open for signature until **Nov. 24, 2026**, after which it is withdrawn and the AAA demand will be filed the following week.
- Conditional on written client authorization by each party and on definitive documentation consistent with this term sheet.

| Juniper Health Staffing, LLC | Pinecrest Senior Living, Inc. |
|---|---|
| _________________________ | _________________________ |
| By counsel — Dolapo Okonkwo to ratify | By counsel — Hanna Lindqvist to ratify |
